what: Dark funk on the FM-1. Pick two of 15 styles and RITUAL summons a whole 4-track song in one press, always in key: acid lines, chopped breaks, warped funk. Mutes, stutter, build and drop for live sets, NEXT suggests your next phrase, a tape echo, and an eye on screen that burns with the music.
author: Polaris Sound Lab
